patch: Only declare pre-sm80 __hmax_nan/__hmin_nan fallbacks when CUDA is older than 12.9. CUDA 12.9 already declares them. Replace __FILE__ in NO_DEVICE_CODE diagnostics with a stable source label so native objects do not disclose build-machine paths; track that header as a build input. On Windows/MSVC, link static CUDART for kernel registration before main so CPU/ROCm launch does not require globally installed CUDA DLLs.
validation: CUDA 12.9 sm75 compilation and actual RTX 4090 AnimeText inference passed. GPU dtype is F32 because portable sm75 kernels do not implement BF16. The executable regular import table contains no NVIDIA/CUDA DLLs. Production CPU LaMa and AnimeText passed with CUDA removed from PATH; all six LaMa/AOT/FLUX CPU and CUDA smokes passed.
